business: Mohamed Al Marzooqi Advocates and Consultancy
owner: the M and L Advocates team
summary: Three UAE offices and a WhatsApp number are strengths, but dead menu links, template labels and no enquiry form appear to cost you clients.

findings.problem: Menu items and the Abu Dhabi, Dubai and Ajman headings link to #, and every practice area card links to one generic page.
findings.cost: Clients cannot reach the office or service they need.
findings.fix: Working menus and a page per practice area.

findings.problem: The label Law Firm / Lawyer appears under all nine practice areas, the Testimonials section shows four identical icons, and the blog link points to a different subdomain.
findings.cost: Template text and repeated icons make the firm look unfinished.

findings.problem: The firm appears as M&L Advocates & Consultancy, Mohamed Al Marzooqi and Mohammed Al Marzouqi, and the LinkedIn address spells the name with three o's.
findings.cost: Changing names weaken trust and search visibility.

findings.problem: EMAIL US links to a contact page with no form, and stats such as 11370+ Happy Clients, 5680+ Cases Done and 100+ Awards Won have no sources or dates.
findings.cost: Unsourced figures and no form lose enquiries and credibility.
findings.fix: A direct enquiry form and sourced, dated figures.

redesign: Working menus and a page per practice area.
A direct enquiry form with WhatsApp.
Sourced figures, credentials and real testimonials.
